comparison.objective: Fit a linear-guide carriage onto a rail, push it past a spring plunger to an end stop, and release; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires undercut rail alignment, constrained insertion, and overcoming a detent, not two-tool screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks rail capture, alignment, passage beyond the plunger, end-stop contact, release, and stillness; candidate checks calibrated angle, both nuts, repeated cycles, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot hardware and retained mechanisms, but rail insertion past a detent does not test preserving an adjustable setting while locking it.
